program.section_heading: Spanish - Associate in Arts for Transfer (ADT) - MAA708 (Cal-GETC)
outcomes: Demonstrate critical thinking skills in Spanish by interpreting and articulating ideas, questions, opinions and information at the high-intermediate level, both orally and in writing.
Analyze the practices, products and perspectives of the Spanish-speaking countries and peoples throughout the world through a comparison of Hispanic cultures and their own.

The list of ANT/ARTH/COMM/ENGL/ETS/GEG/HIST/POLS/SOC courses follows a note saying they are appropriate substitutions only when a student places out of a required course without units; they are not recorded as a requirement block. Reviewer should confirm.
That substitution list includes ENGL-25 Latinx Literature of the United States (3.00), which is not in the closed list.
